display_long_description:
**The Mighty Mine** is a horror exploration-type VR game focused on mining and exploring caves. Follow some simple steps and you can be one of the high rank Minerbots!

# 1. Enter the cave
Enter the ginormous cave system in search for rare **ores and gems.** Just make sure you’re on your toes, as you might not be as lonely as you think…

# 2. Sell ores
Grab any ores you can find and head back to the surface. Once your back at camp, dump all the ores you’ve found in the **grinder.** After selling ores you earn **Tokens** and **XP** depending on the rarity and size of the ore.

# 3. Buy upgrades 
After earning enough **Tokens**, purchase new cave areas and gear that can help you traverse the mines and earn even more Tokens.

# 4. Rinse and repeat
Keep upgrading your gear, levelling up and exploring the cave areas that just seem to get crazier and crazier… Don’t forget to socialise and make friends that can help you while exploring!!
